ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-24 (FB-950): Blocks Status to Presented when Expiration Date is blank or past. Fires only on that transition, so create/revise are unaffected. Pairs with VR_QUOTE_23 (cap TODAY()+60).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Presented"), OR( ISBLANK(ExpirationDate), ExpirationDate < TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Set a valid Expiration Date (today or later, up to 60 days from today) before sending this quote to the customer.
